craft_notes: Sthāyin: fourfold-wasted (manas-cetanā-śakti-ātman: the four named, then wasted fully — O dear — then Bhairava form). Rows: row 1 (four uncut — never trim a ladder). Rupture: dash after fully — wasting, then address, then form. Close: form (bhairava-rūpa — the FORM-word: what wasting yields is form, not void). Rejected: 'four states' vague — killed: mental-consciousness-power-self-mind kept (the verse's four); 'destroyed' — killed: wasted kept (kṣaya gradual, cf. v51's days).

lines: Mental, consciousness, power, self, mind — fourfold:
when wasted fully, O dear — then Bhairava form.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mānasaṃ cetanā śaktir ātmā ceti catuṣṭayam | yadā priye parikṣīṇaṃ tadā tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

reads_against.argmap: What fourfold must be wasted? → The fourfold (manas-cetanā-śakti-ātman) wasted yields Bhairava-form.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness that ends in sovereignty)
